title: Skills and Business
intro: Learn skills, try small projects and start something of your own.

nodes.label: Learn a digital skill
nodes.note: Coding, design, spreadsheets or marketing. Many free courses exist.

nodes.label: Try a small project
nodes.note: Run a school fair stall, sell something small or teach a class. You learn money and teamwork.

nodes.label: Short skill course (certificate)
nodes.note: Weeks to months. Check that the course is approved.

nodes.label: Start-up or college incubator
nodes.note: Get mentors, a space and sometimes small funds.

nodes.label: Freelancer (design, coding, content)
nodes.note: Work for clients on your own time.

nodes.label: Skilled technician
nodes.note: Electrician, solar installer, mobile repair and more.

nodes.label: Self-employed professional
nodes.note: Tutor, caterer, photographer or repair expert.
